auth.label: Prowlarr address (usually port 9696)
auth.help: Where your own Prowlarr runs, as host or host:port over plain http with no URL base, such as 192.168.1.10:9696, with 1337x added as an indexer. 1337x answers with a Cloudflare challenge, so add FlareSolverr in Prowlarr under Settings > Indexers > Indexer Proxies and give it the same tag as the 1337x indexer.

auth.label: Prowlarr indexer id of 1337x
auth.help: Only the number, not a URL or a name. In Prowlarr open Indexers and click 1337x: its Torznab URL reads like http://192.168.1.10:9696/3/, and the 3 is the id.

auth.label: Prowlarr API key
auth.help: In Prowlarr, Settings > General > Security > API Key.
